quote: When a large feedforward neural network is trained on a small training set, it typically performs poorly on held-out test data.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当大型前馈神经网络在小训练集上训练时，通常在留出测试数据上表现很差，这种过拟合需要被减少 [p1]。

quote: the feature detectors have been tuned to work well together on the training data but not on the test data.
claim: 作者指出，过拟合的原因在于特征检测器被调谐为在训练数据上协同工作，而在测试数据上不能 [p2]。

quote: On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5, so a hidden unit cannot rely on other hidden units being present.
claim: 论文提出 dropout：在每次呈现每个训练样本时，每个隐藏单元以 0.5 的概率被随机从网络中省略，使隐藏单元不能依赖其他隐藏单元的存在 [p3]。

quote: we set an upper bound on the L2 norm of the incoming weight vector for each individual hidden unit.
claim: 训练使用标准随机梯度下降，但将通常的权重惩罚改为对每个隐藏单元输入权重向量的 L2 范数设置上界，若权重更新违反该约束则通过除法重新归一化 [p4]。

quote: At test time, we use the “mean network” that contains all of the hidden units but with their outgoing weights halved
claim: 测试时使用包含所有隐藏单元但输出权重减半的“mean network” [p5]。

quote: It contains 60,000 28x28 training images of individual hand written digits and 10,000 test images.

quote: the best published result for a standard feedforward neural network is 160 errors on the test set.
claim: 在 MNIST 上，不使用任何技巧的标准前馈神经网络最佳已发表结果为 160 个测试错误，使用 50% dropout 和每个隐藏单元输入权重的独立 L2 约束可降至约 130 个错误，再随机丢弃 20% 像素可进一步降至约 110 个错误 [p6]。

quote: Without dropout, the recognition rate is $22.7$ % and with dropout this improves to $19.7$ %, which is a record for methods that do not use any information about speaker identity.
claim: 在 TIMIT 上，无 dropout 时识别率为 22.7%，使用 dropout 后提升至 19.7%，这是不使用说话人身份信息的方法中的记录 [p9]。

quote: The best published error rate on the test set, without using transformed data, is 18.5%. We achieved an error rate of 16.6%
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，最佳已发表无变换数据错误率为 18.5%，作者达到 16.6%，在最后隐藏层使用 dropout 后达到 15.6% [p10]。

quote: We achieved comparable performance of 48.6% error using a single neural network
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，作者使用单个神经网络达到 48.6% 错误，在第六隐藏层使用 50% dropout 后降至创纪录的 42.4% [p11]。

quote: A feedforward neural network with 2 fully connected layers of 2000 hidden units trained with backpropagation gets 31.05% error on the test set. This is reduced to 29.62% by using 50% dropout
claim: 在 Reuters 上，标准反向传播错误率为 31.05%，使用 50% dropout 后降至 29.62% [p13]。

quote: When deeper networks are able to start converging, a degradation problem has been exposed: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated (which might be unsurprising) and then degrades rapidly.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当网络能够开始收敛时，随着深度增加会出现退化问题——准确率饱和后迅速下降，且这种退化并非由过拟合引起，给适当深的模型增加更多层反而导致更高的训练误差 [S1.p3]。

quote: Driven by the significance of depth, a question arises: Is learning better networks as easy as stacking more layers?
claim: 作者指出，深度对网络性能至关重要，但简单地堆叠更多层并不能轻易获得更好的网络 [S1.p2]。

quote: Instead of hoping each few stacked layers directly fit a desired underlying mapping, we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping.
claim: 论文提出深度残差学习框架，让堆叠的非线性层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，而不是直接拟合目标映射 H(x)，原始映射被重新表述为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。

quote: Identity shortcut connections add neither extra parameter nor computational complexity.
claim: 该表述通过恒等映射的捷径连接实现，捷径连接不引入额外参数或计算复杂度，整个网络仍可用 SGD 端到端训练 [S1.p6]。

quote: But we will show by experiments that the identity mapping is sufficient for addressing the degradation problem and is economical
claim: 当输入输出维度不一致时，可用线性投影 W_s 匹配维度，但实验表明恒等映射足以解决退化问题且更经济 [S3.SS2.p3]。

quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes.
claim: 论文在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集（1000 类，128 万训练图像，5 万验证图像，10 万测试图像）上评估方法，报告 top-1 和 top-5 错误率 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.

quote: The 50/101/152-layer ResNets are more accurate than the 34-layer ones by considerable margins (Table 3 and 5).

claim: 作者还在英语成分句法分析任务上验证泛化能力，使用 Penn Treebank 的 WSJ 部分约 40K 训练句，并在半监督设置下使用约 17M 句 [S6.SS3.p2]。

claim: 在 WMT 2014 英德翻译任务上，big 模型比此前报告的最佳模型（含集成模型）高出 2.0 BLEU 以上，取得 28.4 BLEU 的新最优结果 [S6.SS1.p1]。

quote: our big model achieves a BLEU score of $41.0$, outperforming all of the previously published single models
claim: 在 WMT 2014 英法任务上，big 模型取得 41.0 BLEU，优于所有此前已发表的单模型 [S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: While single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads.

claim: 用学习式位置嵌入替换正弦位置编码，结果几乎相同 [S6.SS2.p3]。

quote: In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions
claim: 作者指出，自注意力将任意两位置间的操作数降为常数，但代价是注意力加权位置平均导致有效分辨率降低，他们用多头注意力来抵消这一影响 [S2.p1]。

quote: self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$ in the input sequence centered around the respective output position
claim: 对于涉及很长序列的任务，作者提出可将自注意力限制在输入序列中以相应输出位置为中心、大小为 r 的邻域内，并计划在未来工作中进一步研究该做法 [S4.p4]。

quote: They cannot easily expand or revise their memory, can’t straightforwardly provide insight into their predictions, and may produce “hallucinations”.
claim: 论文要解决预训练语言模型在知识密集型任务上的局限：它们难以扩展或修正记忆、无法直接提供预测依据，并可能产生“幻觉” [S1.p1]。

quote: They cannot easily expand or revise their memory, can’t straightforwardly provide insight into their predictions, and may produce “hallucinations”.

quote: They cannot easily expand or revise their memory, can’t straightforwardly provide insight into their predictions, and may produce “hallucinations”.
claim: 作者希望将这种混合记忆引入序列到序列模型，并探索通用的微调方法 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

claim: 作者希望将这种混合记忆引入序列到序列模型，并探索通用的微调方法 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

claim: RAG 使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。

quote: The RAG-Sequence model uses the same retrieved document to generate the complete sequence.
claim: 检索到的文档被视为隐变量，通过 top-K 近似进行边缘化，提出 RAG-Sequence（整个序列使用同一文档）和 RAG-Token（每个 token 可使用不同文档）两种形式 [S2.p2][S2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: In the RAG-Token model we can draw a different latent document for each target token and marginalize accordingly.
claim: 检索到的文档被视为隐变量，通过 top-K 近似进行边缘化，提出 RAG-Sequence（整个序列使用同一文档）和 RAG-Token（每个 token 可使用不同文档）两种形式 [S2.p2][S2.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S2.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: We jointly train the retriever and generator components without any direct supervision on what document should be retrieved.
claim: 训练时联合微调查询编码器和 BART 生成器，文档编码器与索引保持固定 [S2.SS4.p1]。

quote: we use a single Wikipedia dump for our non-parametric knowledge source. Following and, we use the December 2018 dump.
claim: 实验使用 2018 年 12 月 Wikipedia dump，每篇文章切分为 100 词块，共 21M 文档，用 FAISS 构建 MIPS 索引 [S3.p1]。

quote: we use a single Wikipedia dump for our non-parametric knowledge source. Following and, we use the December 2018 dump.
claim: 训练时检索 top k 文档，k 取 5 或 10，测试时 k 由开发集确定 [S3.p1]。

quote: We consider four popular open-domain QA datasets: Natural Questions (NQ), TriviaQA (TQA). WebQuestions (WQ) and CuratedTrec (CT).
claim: 任务包括开放域问答（NQ、TriviaQA、WebQuestions、CuratedTrec）[S3.SS1.p1]、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG）[S3.SS2.p1]、Jeopardy 问题生成 [S3.SS3.p1] 和 FEVER 事实核查 [S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: we use the MSMARCO NLG task v2.1.
claim: 任务包括开放域问答（NQ、TriviaQA、WebQuestions、CuratedTrec）[S3.SS1.p1]、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG）[S3.SS2.p1]、Jeopardy 问题生成 [S3.SS3.p1] 和 FEVER 事实核查 [S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: we propose the more demanding task of generating Jeopardy questions.
claim: 任务包括开放域问答（NQ、TriviaQA、WebQuestions、CuratedTrec）[S3.SS1.p1]、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG）[S3.SS2.p1]、Jeopardy 问题生成 [S3.SS3.p1] 和 FEVER 事实核查 [S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: FEVER requires classifying whether a natural language claim is supported or refuted by Wikipedia, or whether there is not enough information to decide.
claim: 任务包括开放域问答（NQ、TriviaQA、WebQuestions、CuratedTrec）[S3.SS1.p1]、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG）[S3.SS2.p1]、Jeopardy 问题生成 [S3.SS3.p1] 和 FEVER 事实核查 [S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: On all four open-domain QA tasks, RAG sets a new state of the art (only on the T5-comparable split for TQA).
claim: 在四个开放域问答任务上，RAG 均取得当时最优结果（TriviaQA 仅在 T5 可比划分上）[S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: RAG-Sequence outperforms BART on Open MS-MARCO NLG by 2.6 Bleu points and 2.6 Rouge-L points.
claim: RAG 在 MS-MARCO NLG 上比 BART 高 2.6 Bleu 和 2.6 Rouge-L [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
claim: 在 Jeopardy 问题生成中，RAG-Token 优于 RAG-Sequence，两者均优于 BART [S4.SS3.p1]；

quote: RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
claim: 人工评估中 RAG 在 42.7% 的情况下比 BART 更事实准确，而 BART 仅在 7.1% 的情况下更事实准确 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: For 3-way classification, RAG scores are within 4.3% of state-of-the-art models
claim: 在 FEVER 三分类上，RAG 与当时最优模型的差距在 4.3% 以内 [S4.SS4.p1]。

quote: RAG-Sequence’s generations are more diverse than RAG-Token’s, and both are significantly more diverse than BART without needing any diversity-promoting decoding.
claim: RAG 生成比 BART 更多样 [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: This shows we can update RAG’s world knowledge by simply replacing its non-parametric memory.
claim: 通过替换索引，RAG 可更新世界知识 [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: we observed that for some tasks such as story generation, the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input.
claim: 作者指出，在故事生成等任务中检索组件可能“崩溃”，即无论输入如何都检索相同文档，此时生成器会忽略文档，RAG 表现与 BART 相当 [A8.p1]。

quote: As FEVER uses a different Wikipedia dump to us, directly tackling this task is not straightforward. We hope to address this in future work.
claim: FEVER 的另一个子任务（抽取证据句子）因使用不同 Wikipedia dump 而难以直接处理，作者希望未来解决 [A5.p1]。

quote: We did not find that these improved performance, so in the interests of simplicity, we omit them.
claim: 此外，作者尝试的“空文档”机制未能提升性能，因此省略 [A6.p1]。

quote: there is still a need for task-specific datasets and task-specific fine-tuning
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：现有预训练加微调范式虽然架构任务无关，但仍需要每个任务数千到数十万个特定任务的标注样本进行微调 [S1.p2]。

quote: humans can generally perform a new language task from only a few examples or from simple instructions
claim: 作者指出，人类通常只需少量示例或简单指令即可完成新的语言任务，而当前 NLP 系统仍难以做到这一点 [abstract]。

quote: humans can generally perform a new language task from only a few examples or from simple instructions
claim: 因此，论文希望测试扩大语言模型规模是否能大幅提升任务无关的少样本性能 [abstract]。

quote: we train GPT-3, an autoregressive language model with 175 billion parameters, 10x more than any previous non-sparse language model
claim: 论文训练了 GPT-3，一个 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型，参数量比此前任何非稀疏语言模型多 10 倍 [abstract]。

quote: we use alternating dense and locally banded sparse attention patterns in the layers of the transformer
claim: 模型架构与 GPT-2 相同，但在 transformer 层中使用交替的稠密和局部带状稀疏注意力模式，并训练了从 1.25 亿到 1750 亿参数的 8 种不同规模模型 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: we train GPT-3, an autoregressive language model with 175 billion parameters, 10x more than any previous non-sparse language model
claim: 评估时，GPT-3 不进行任何梯度更新或微调，任务和少样本示例完全通过文本交互指定 [abstract]。

quote: we evaluate GPT-3 under 3 conditions: (a) “few-shot learning”
claim: 论文在少样本、单样本和零样本三种条件下评估模型，少样本通常允许 10 到 100 个示例放入上下文窗口 [S1.p9]。

quote: we evaluate GPT-3 on over two dozen NLP datasets, as well as several novel tasks designed to test rapid adaptation
claim: 论文在超过两打 NLP 数据集以及若干为测试快速适应而设计的新任务上评估 GPT-3 [S1.p9]。

quote: we group the datasets into 9 categories representing roughly similar tasks
claim: 评估覆盖语言建模、完形填空、闭卷问答、翻译、Winograd 风格任务、常识推理、阅读理解、SuperGLUE 和 NLI 等类别 [S3.p3]。

quote: we test GPT-3’s ability to perform arithmetic
claim: 此外还设计了算术、单词打乱、SAT 类比、新闻文章生成、学习使用新词和纠正英语语法等合成与定性任务 [S3.SS9.p1]。

quote: we also train a series of smaller models (ranging from 125 million parameters to 13 billion parameters)
claim: 论文还训练了从 1.25 亿到 130 亿参数的较小模型，以在零样本、单样本和少样本设置下与 GPT-3 比较 [S1.p16]。

quote: GPT-3 achieves promising results in the zero-shot and one-shot settings
claim: GPT-3 在零样本和单样本设置下取得有希望的结果，少样本设置下有时可与甚至偶尔超过最先进的微调模型 [S1.p11]。

quote: GPT-3 achieves promising results in the zero-shot and one-shot settings
claim: 例如在 CoQA 上，GPT-3 零样本达到 81.5 F1，单样本 84.0 F1，少样本 85.0 F1 [S1.p11]；

quote: GPT-3 achieves promising results in the zero-shot and one-shot settings
claim: 在 TriviaQA 上，零样本 64.3%、单样本 68.0%、少样本 71.2%，其中少样本结果在闭卷设置下相对微调模型达到最先进 [S1.p11]。

quote: unscrambling words, performing arithmetic, and using novel words in a sentence after seeing them defined only once
claim: GPT-3 还在需要即时推理或快速适应的任务上表现出单样本和少样本能力，包括打乱单词、算术和在只见过一次定义后使用新词 [S1.p12]。

quote: mean human accuracy at detecting articles that were produced by the 175B parameter model was barely above chance at $\sim 52\%$
claim: 在新闻文章生成上，人类评估者区分 GPT-3 生成文章与人类撰写文章的准确率仅略高于随机水平，约为 52% [S3.SS9.SSS4.p5]。

quote: This includes natural language inference tasks like the ANLI dataset, and some reading comprehension datasets like RACE or QuAC
claim: 同时，论文发现部分任务上少样本性能仍不佳，包括 ANLI 等自然语言推理任务以及 RACE、QuAC 等阅读理解数据集 [S1.p13]。

quote: GPT-3 samples still sometimes repeat themselves semantically at the document level, start to lose coherence over sufficiently long passages, contradict themselves
claim: 作者承认 GPT-3 在文本合成和若干 NLP 任务上仍有明显弱点，例如样本在文档级别语义重复、长段落中失去连贯性、自相矛盾，以及偶尔出现不合逻辑的句子或段落 [S5.p2]。

quote: GPT-3 samples still sometimes repeat themselves semantically at the document level, start to lose coherence over sufficiently long passages, contradict themselves
claim: GPT-3 在部分“比较”类任务上单样本甚至少样本表现仅略好于随机，例如判断两个词在句中用法是否相同（WIC）或一句是否蕴含另一句（ANLI），以及部分阅读理解任务 [S5.p2]。

quote: our experiments do not include any bidirectional architectures or other training objectives such as denoising
claim: 作者还指出模型存在结构和算法局限，因为实验未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能以牺牲部分任务性能为代价 [S5.p3]。

quote: ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time, or if it simply recognizes and identifies tasks that it has learned during training
claim: 此外，作者承认少样本学习存在不确定性：不清楚模型是在推理时真正从头学习新任务，还是仅识别训练中已学过的任务 [S5.p6]。

quote: In computer vision, however, convolutional architectures remain dominant.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中卷积架构仍占主导，能否不依赖 CNN，将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像分类 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中卷积架构仍占主导，能否不依赖 CNN，将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像分类 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: In vision, attention is either applied in conjunction with convolutional networks, or used to replace certain components of convolutional networks while keeping their overall structure in place.
claim: 其动机来自 Transformer 在 NLP 中的成功与可扩展性，而此前视觉中的自注意力要么与卷积结合，要么替换卷积网络的某些组件但保留整体结构 [abstract][S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: Self-attention-based architectures, in particular Transformers, have become the model of choice in natural language processing (NLP).
claim: 其动机来自 Transformer 在 NLP 中的成功与可扩展性，而此前视觉中的自注意力要么与卷积结合，要么替换卷积网络的某些组件但保留整体结构 [abstract][S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: In computer vision, however, convolutional architectures remain dominant.
claim: 其动机来自 Transformer 在 NLP 中的成功与可扩展性，而此前视觉中的自注意力要么与卷积结合，要么替换卷积网络的某些组件但保留整体结构 [abstract][S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.
claim: 作者希望以尽可能少的修改，把图像当作 patch 序列处理，验证纯 Transformer 在大规模预训练下能否与最优卷积网络竞争 [S1.p3][S2.p3]。

quote: our work goes further to demonstrate that large scale pre-training makes vanilla transformers competitive with (or even better than) state-of-the-art CNNs.
claim: 作者希望以尽可能少的修改，把图像当作 patch 序列处理，验证纯 Transformer 在大规模预训练下能否与最优卷积网络竞争 [S1.p3][S2.p3]。

quote: we reshape the image $\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}$ into a sequence of flattened 2D patches
claim: ViT 将图像 \(\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}\) 切分为固定大小的二维 patch，展平后经可训练线性投影映射到维度 \(D\)，得到 patch embeddings [S3.SS1.p1]。
与 BERT 类似，序列前加入一个可学习的 [class] token，其编码器输出作为图像表示用于分类 [S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: Similar to BERT’s [class] token, we prepend a learnable embedding to the sequence of embedded patches
claim: 与 BERT 类似，序列前加入一个可学习的 [class] token，其编码器输出作为图像表示用于分类 [S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: Position embeddings are added to the patch embeddings to retain positional information.
claim: 模型加入可学习的一维位置嵌入，编码器由多头自注意力和 MLP 交替组成，每个 block 前用 LayerNorm、后接残差连接 [S3.SS1.p3][S3.SS1.p4]。

quote: The Transformer encoder consists of alternating layers of multiheaded self-attention (MSA, see Appendix A) and MLP blocks
claim: 模型加入可学习的一维位置嵌入，编码器由多头自注意力和 MLP 交替组成，每个 block 前用 LayerNorm、后接残差连接 [S3.SS1.p3][S3.SS1.p4]。

quote: we remove the pre-trained prediction head and attach a zero-initialized $D\times K$ feedforward layer
claim: 微调时移除预训练预测头，接零初始化的 \(D\times K\) 前馈层，并可在更高分辨率下对预训练位置嵌入做二维插值 [S3.SS2.p1]。

quote: we use the ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset with 1k classes and 1.3M images
claim: 预训练使用 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 高分辨率图像），并迁移到 ImageNet、ImageNet-ReaL、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102 以及 19 任务的 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: We also evaluate on the 19-task VTAB classification suite.
claim: 预训练使用 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 高分辨率图像），并迁移到 ImageNet、ImageNet-ReaL、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102 以及 19 任务的 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: The “Base” and “Large” models are directly adopted from BERT and we add the larger “Huge” model.
claim: 模型变体基于 BERT 配置，包括 Base、Large 和新增的 Huge，并用 ViT-L/16 等记号表示模型规模与 patch 大小 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: For the baseline CNNs, we use ResNet, but replace the Batch Normalization layers with Group Normalization
claim: 基线 CNN 使用将 BatchNorm 替换为 GroupNorm 的 ResNet（ResNet (BiT)），混合模型将 CNN 特征图输入 ViT [S4.SS1.p4]。

quote: We train all models, including ResNets, using Adam with $\beta_{1}=0.9$, $\beta_{2}=0.999$, a batch size of 4096
claim: 训练使用 Adam、batch size 4096、权重衰减 0.1，微调使用 SGD with momentum、batch size 512 [S4.SS1.p5]。

quote: First, we pre-train ViT models on datasets of increasing size: ImageNet, ImageNet-21k, and JFT-300M.
claim: 此外还进行了预训练数据规模实验、JFT-300M 上的受控 scaling 研究、注意力分析以及掩码 patch 预测的自监督初步实验 [S4.SS3.p2][S4.SS4.p1][S4.SS5.p3][S4.SS6.p1]。

quote: We perform a controlled scaling study of different models by evaluating transfer performance from JFT-300M.
claim: 此外还进行了预训练数据规模实验、JFT-300M 上的受控 scaling 研究、注意力分析以及掩码 patch 预测的自监督初步实验 [S4.SS3.p2][S4.SS4.p1][S4.SS5.p3][S4.SS6.p1]。
此外还进行了预训练数据规模实验、JFT-300M 上的受控 scaling 研究、注意力分析以及掩码 patch 预测的自监督初步实验 [S4.SS3.p2][S4.SS4.p1][S4.SS5.p3][S4.SS6.p1]。

quote: We also perform a preliminary exploration on masked patch prediction for self-supervision
claim: 此外还进行了预训练数据规模实验、JFT-300M 上的受控 scaling 研究、注意力分析以及掩码 patch 预测的自监督初步实验 [S4.SS3.p2][S4.SS4.p1][S4.SS5.p3][S4.SS6.p1]。

quote: The smaller ViT-L/16 model pre-trained on JFT-300M outperforms BiT-L (which is pre-trained on the same dataset) on all tasks, while requiring substantially less computational resources to train.
claim: 在 JFT-300M 上预训练后，较小的 ViT-L/16 在所有任务上超过同样在该数据集上预训练的 BiT-L，且所需计算资源显著更少；更大的 ViT-H/14 进一步提升性能，尤其在 ImageNet、CIFAR-100 和 VTAB 上 [S4.SS2.p2]。

quote: the best model reaches the accuracy of $88.55\%$ on ImageNet, $90.72\%$ on ImageNet-ReaL, $94.55\%$ on CIFAR-100, and $77.63\%$ on the VTAB suite of 19 tasks.
claim: 最佳模型在 ImageNet 上达到 88.55%、ImageNet-ReaL 上 90.72%、CIFAR-100 上 94.55%、VTAB 19 任务上 77.63% [S1.p5]。

quote: While large ViT models perform worse than BiT ResNets (shaded area) when pre-trained on small datasets, they shine when pre-trained on larger datasets.
claim: 在预训练数据规模实验中，ViT 在小型数据集上不如 BiT ResNet，但随着数据增大而反超，且更大的 ViT 变体随数据增长超过较小变体 [S4.F4][S4.SS3.p2]。

quote: Only with JFT-300M, do we see the full benefit of larger models.
claim: 在预训练数据规模实验中，ViT 在小型数据集上不如 BiT ResNet，但随着数据增大而反超，且更大的 ViT 变体随数据增长超过较小变体 [S4.F4][S4.SS3.p2]。

quote: ViT uses approximately $2-4\times$ less compute to attain the same performance (average over 5 datasets).
claim: 受控 scaling 研究表明，ViT 在性能/计算权衡上优于 ResNet，达到相同性能约少用 2–4 倍计算；混合模型在小计算预算下略优于纯 ViT，但差距随模型增大而消失 [S4.SS4.p2]。

quote: We find that some heads attend to most of the image already in the lowest layers
claim: 注意力分析显示，部分注意力头在最低层就关注图像大部分区域，注意力距离随网络深度增加，模型关注与分类语义相关的区域 [S4.SS5.p3]。

quote: our smaller ViT-B/16 model achieves 79.9% accuracy on ImageNet, a significant improvement of 2% to training from scratch, but still 4% behind supervised pre-training.
claim: 自监督掩码 patch 预测使 ViT-B/16 在 ImageNet 上达到 79.9%，比从头训练提升 2%，但仍比监督预训练低 4% [S4.SS6.p1]。

quote: When trained on mid-sized datasets such as ImageNet without strong regularization, these models yield modest accuracies of a few percentage points below ResNets of comparable size.
claim: 作者指出，在中型数据集（如 ImageNet）上不加强正则化训练时，ViT 精度比同规模 ResNet 低几个百分点，并认为这可能是因为 Transformer 缺少 CNN 固有的平移等变性和局部性等归纳偏置，在数据不足时泛化不佳 [S1.p4]。

quote: One is to apply ViT to other computer vision tasks, such as detection and segmentation.
claim: 作者还指出，将 ViT 应用于检测、分割等其他视觉任务仍是待解决的挑战，自监督预训练与大规模监督预训练之间仍有较大差距，需要继续探索 [S5.p2]。

quote: we note that pre-training efficiency may be affected not only by the architecture choice, but also other parameters, such as training schedule, optimizer, weight decay, etc.

quote: What has led to this convergence? Will it continue? And ultimately, where does it end?

quote: different models are all trying to arrive at a representation of reality, meaning a representation of the joint distribution over events in the world that generate the data we observe

quote: To measure cross-modal alignment, we use paired datasets to bridge the two modalities.

quote: Our contrastive learner tries to classify if a pair is positive or negative by learning a representation $f_{X}\colon X\rightarrow\mathbb{R}^{d}$ such that the dot-product kernel approximates the log odds ratio up to some offset
claim: 此外，作者在理想化世界模型下分析了一类对比学习器，推导其最优解会逼近 PMI 核 [S4.SS2.p2][S4.SS2.p4]。

quote: Therefore, the contrastive learners we consider are minimized by a representation $f_{X}$ whose kernel is $K_{\mathsf{PMI}}$ (up to a constant offset).

quote: We argue that LM agents represent a new category of end user, with their own needs and abilities.
claim: 作者指出，现有接口是为人类用户设计的，而 LM agent 代表一类具有自身需求与能力的新终端用户 [S2.p1]。

quote: it fails to provide simple commands to edit a small file segment, and does not provide any feedback if the user makes an invalid edit.
claim: 其动机在于，LM agent 直接使用 Linux shell 时难以可靠地执行操作，例如无法提供编辑小段文件的简单命令，且对无效编辑不给出反馈，这些缺陷严重妨碍了性能 [S1.p2]。

quote: SWE-agent’s ACI instead offers a small set of simple actions for viewing, searching through and editing files.
claim: 论文提出 SWE-agent，一个由 LM 与 ACI 组成的系统，其 ACI 提供一小组简单动作用于查看、搜索和编辑文件，并配有 guardrails 防止常见错误，每一步都向 agent 返回具体而简洁的反馈 [S1.p3]。

quote: At each step, SWE-agent generates a thought and a command, then incorporates the feedback from the command’s execution in the environment
claim: ACI 包含搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器和上下文管理等组件，agent 每步生成一个 thought 和一个 command，并将命令执行反馈纳入后续输入 [S3.p1]。

quote: Actions should be simple and easy to understand for agents.
claim: 设计遵循四条原则：动作应简单易懂、动作应紧凑高效、环境反馈应信息丰富但简洁、guardrails 应能缓解错误传播并加速恢复 [S2.p5]。

quote: we assume a fixed LM and focus on designing the ACI to improve its performance
claim: 作者在固定 LM 的前提下，通过人工检查 agent 行为和网格搜索来选择最佳 ACI 配置 [S2.p4]。

quote: We primarily evaluate on the SWE-bench dataset, which includes $2,294$ task instances from $12$ different repositories of popular Python packages.
claim: 论文主要在 SWE-bench 上评估，该数据集包含来自 12 个流行 Python 包的 2,294 个任务实例；消融与分析在 SWE-bench Lite 上进行，该子集包含 300 个实例，聚焦自包含的功能性 bug 修复 [S4.p1]。

quote: We primarily evaluate on the SWE-bench dataset, which includes $2,294$ task instances from $12$ different repositories of popular Python packages.
claim: 此外还用 HumanEvalFix 测试基本的代码编辑能力 [S4.p1]。

claim: 所有结果、消融和分析基于 GPT-4 Turbo 和 Claude 3 Opus 两个 LM [S4.p2]。

quote: The first setting is the non-interactive, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baselines established in.

quote: We report % Resolved or pass $@$ $1$ as the main metric
claim: 主要指标为 % Resolved 或 pass@1，并报告平均 API 推理成本，单实例预算设为 4 美元 [S4.p5]。

quote: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo achieves the best performance all-around, successfully solving $12.47$ % ( $286$ / $2,294$) of the full SWE-bench test set and $18.00$ % ( $54$ / $300$) of the Lite split.
claim: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo 在所有系统中表现最佳，解决了完整 SWE-bench 测试集的 12.47%（286/2,294）和 Lite 子集的 18.00%（54/300）[S5.p1]。

quote: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo achieves the best performance all-around, successfully solving $12.47$ % ( $286$ / $2,294$) of the full SWE-bench test set and $18.00$ % ( $54$ / $300$) of the Lite split.
claim: 相比 Lite 上的 RAG，SWE-agent 成本高 8–13 倍，但 % Resolved 率提升 6.7 倍；相比同样使用 GPT-4 Turbo 的 Shell-only，相对提升 64% [S5.p1]。

quote: SWE-agent yields strong performance on HumanEvalFix with $88.3$ % pass@1 rate.
claim: 在 HumanEvalFix 上，SWE-agent 取得 88.3% 的 pass@1 [S5.p2]。

quote: leading to even worse performance than the not having additional search tools at all ( $15.7$ % $\downarrow$ 2.3 for No search vs. $12.0$ % $\downarrow$ 6.0 with Iterative search).
claim: 消融显示，Iterative search 在大量搜索结果时表现甚至差于没有额外搜索工具（15.7% vs. 12.0%），无文件编辑器时性能降至 10.3%，无 linting 时降至 15.0% [S5.SS1.p3][S5.SS1.p4][S5.SS1.p5]。

claim: 消融显示，Iterative search 在大量搜索结果时表现甚至差于没有额外搜索工具（15.7% vs. 12.0%），无文件编辑器时性能降至 10.3%，无 linting 时降至 15.0% [S5.SS1.p3][S5.SS1.p4][S5.SS1.p5]。

quote: SWE-agent usually begins with either writing reproduction code and/or localizing the issue’s cause to specific lines of code.
claim: 行为分析发现，agent 通常先复现和/或定位问题，随后进入“编辑—执行”循环 [S5.SS2.p2][S5.SS2.p3]；

claim: 行为分析发现，agent 通常先复现和/或定位问题，随后进入“编辑—执行”循环 [S5.SS2.p2][S5.SS2.p3]；

quote: out of $2,294$ task instances, $1,185$ ( $51.7$ %) of SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo trajectories have $1$ + failed edits.
claim: 2,294 个任务中有 1,185 个（51.7%）的轨迹出现至少一次失败编辑，编辑尝试最终成功概率为 90.5%，但一次失败后降至 57.2% [S5.SS2.p4]。

quote: Our main goal is to develop a rich body of theoretical connections between structured SSMs and variants of attention.
claim: 本文旨在建立结构化 SSM 与注意力变体之间的丰富理论联系，从而将原本为 Transformer 开发的算法和系统优化迁移到 SSM 上，以构建性能更好且随序列长度扩展更高效的基础模型 [S1.p2]。

quote: However, the development of SSMs have appeared disjoint from the community’s collective effort to improve Transformers, such as understanding them theoretically as well as optimizing them on modern hardware.
claim: 作者指出，SSM 的发展与社区改进 Transformer 的努力（如理论理解和硬件优化）显得脱节，导致 SSM 比 Transformer 更难理解和实验，且从算法和系统角度看，训练 SSM 与训练 Transformer 一样高效仍然具有挑战性 [S1.p1]。

quote: Our framework connecting structured SSMs and variants of attention, which we call structured state space duality (SSD), is made through the abstractions of structured matrices
claim: 作者提出了结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过半可分矩阵这一结构化矩阵抽象，将 SSM 与注意力变体联系起来 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Our framework connecting structured SSMs and variants of attention, which we call structured state space duality (SSD), is made through the abstractions of structured matrices
claim: 该框架表明 SSM 等价于半可分矩阵，并证明任何具有快速循环形式的核注意力方法必定是 SSM [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Instead of computing the whole matrix in either recurrent or attention mode, we perform a block decomposition of the matrix.
claim: 基于此，作者提出了 SSD 算法，利用半可分矩阵的分块分解，对角块使用二次注意力模式计算，非对角块利用秩结构分解为更小的循环 [S6.p4]。

quote: We introduce a new SSD algorithm, based on block decompositions of semiseparable matrices, that takes advantage of both the linear SSM recurrence and quadratic dual form, obtaining optimal tradeoffs on all main efficiency axes
claim: 该算法结合了线性 SSM 循环和二次对偶形式的优势，在训练和推理计算、内存使用以及利用矩阵乘法单元方面取得最优权衡 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: We compare on a challenging version of the MQAR setup from, using a harder task, longer sequences, and smaller models.
claim: 作者在合成联想回忆任务（MQAR）上评估了 Mamba-2，该任务使用更难的设置、更长的序列和更小的模型，基线包括标准多头 softmax 注意力和 Based 架构 [S9.SS1.p2]。

quote: The model sizes (depth and width) follow GPT3 specifications, from 125m to 2.7B. We use the Pile dataset
claim: 在语言建模上，作者在 Pile 数据集上训练了从约 125M 到 2.7B 参数的模型，遵循 GPT3 规格和 Chinchilla 协议，并与 Mamba 和 Transformer++ 进行比较 [S9.SS2.p1][S9.SS2.SSS1.p2]。

quote: Figure 9 shows scaling laws under the standard Chinchilla protocol, on models from $\approx 125M$ to $\approx 1.3B$ parameters.
claim: 在语言建模上，作者在 Pile 数据集上训练了从约 125M 到 2.7B 参数的模型，遵循 GPT3 规格和 Chinchilla 协议，并与 Mamba 和 Transformer++ 进行比较 [S9.SS2.p1][S9.SS2.SSS1.p2]。

quote: We benchmark the speed of the SSD algorithm against Mamba’s scan implementation and FlashAttention-2
claim: 此外，作者对 SSD 算法与 Mamba 的扫描实现和 FlashAttention-2 进行了速度基准测试 [S9.SS3.p1]，并消融了 Mamba-2 的块设计、多头结构和核近似等设计选择 [S9.SS4.SSS1.p1][S9.SS4.SSS2.p2][S9.SS4.SSS3.p1]。

quote: While Mamba-1 struggles on this task, Mamba-2 performs well across all settings.
claim: 在 MQAR 任务上，Mamba-2 在所有设置下表现良好，即使在控制状态尺寸（N=16）时也显著优于 Mamba-1，并且增大状态尺寸（从 N=16 到 N=64 和 N=256）持续提升性能 [S9.SS1.p3]。

quote: finding that it Pareto dominates Mamba and Transformer++ in both perplexity and wall-clock time.
claim: 在语言建模上，Mamba-2 在困惑度和实际运行时间上帕累托优于 Mamba 和 Transformer++ [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]，例如 2.7B 参数的 Mamba-2 在 Pile 上训练 300B token 后，性能超过 Mamba-2.8B、Pythia-2.8B 甚至 Pythia-6.9B [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。

quote: it is 2-8 $\times$ faster than Mamba’s fused associative scan, which does not leverage matmul units.
claim: 速度方面，SSD 比 Mamba 的融合扫描快 2-8 倍，并在序列长度 2K 及以上快于 FlashAttention-2 [S9.SS3.p1]。

quote: We hypothesize that it may be possible to refine our structured matrix algorithms to improve to the general diagonal SSM case as well.

quote: We emphasize however that SSD and vanilla linear attention differ in the inclusion of the 1-semiseparable mask $L$, while the various linear attention methods in the literature were derived to approximate softmax attention without this term; thus, our negative results may be not unexpected.

quote: For pretraining, we use a large 3D molecular dataset proposed by the authors of the Uni-Mol model.

quote: For pretraining, we use a large 3D molecular dataset proposed by the authors of the Uni-Mol model.

claim: 训练方面，作者在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 上用 s1K 做监督微调得到 s1-32B，训练在 16 张 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上耗时 26 分钟 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: We select three representative reasoning benchmarks widely used in the field: AIME24 has 30 problems
claim: 评估使用 AIME24（30 题）、MATH500（500 题）和 GPQA Diamond（198 题）三个基准，默认温度 0 并测量准确率 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: We benchmark s1-32B against: OpenAI o1 series
claim: 对比模型包括 OpenAI o1 系列、DeepSeek r1 系列、QwQ-32B-preview、Sky-T1-32B-Preview、Bespoke-32B 和 Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Experimental [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: Here we test the importance of combining them and the overall efficacy of our selection.
claim: 消融实验覆盖数据选择（仅质量、仅多样性、仅难度、全量 59K）和测试时扩展方法（budget forcing、token/step/class-conditional control、rejection sampling）[S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: In Table 3 we compare the test-time scaling methods we have introduced in §3.
claim: 消融实验覆盖数据选择（仅质量、仅多样性、仅难度、全量 59K）和测试时扩展方法（budget forcing、token/step/class-conditional control、rejection sampling）[S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
claim: s1-32B 在竞赛数学题上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%（MATH 和 AIME24）[abstract]。

quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
claim: 配合 budget forcing，s1-32B 在 AIME24 上可从 50% 外推到 57% [abstract]。

quote: Random selection, selecting samples with the longest reasoning traces, or only selecting maximally diverse samples all lead to significantly worse performance (around $-$ 30% on AIME24 on average).
claim: 数据消融显示，随机选择、仅选最长推理轨迹或仅选最大多样性都会导致性能显著变差（AIME24 上平均约 -30%），而训练全部 59K 样本相比 1K 选择没有带来实质提升 [S1.p3]。

quote: we find that budget forcing provides perfect control, good scaling, and leads to our best AIME24 score
claim: 测试时扩展方法比较中，budget forcing 具有完美可控性、良好扩展斜率和最佳 AIME24 分数 [S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: we find that simply sampling until the generation fits a specific length leads to an inverse scaling trend
claim: 此外，rejection sampling 出现反向扩展趋势 [S5.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: it has two key limitations when scaling further: it eventually flattens out ( Figure 4), and the context window of the underlying language model constrains it.
claim: 作者指出 budget forcing 在进一步扩展时有两个关键限制：性能最终会趋于平坦，且受底层语言模型上下文窗口约束 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Suppressing the end-of-thinking token delimiter too often can lead the model into repetitive loops instead of continued reasoning.
claim: 此外，抑制结束思考分隔符过于频繁可能导致模型陷入重复循环而非继续推理 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: It is an open question whether one can achieve their performance with just 1,000 samples.
claim: 作者还提到，能否仅用 1,000 个样本达到 r1-32B 的性能仍是一个开放问题 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Complex reasoning has long been considered one of the most challenging capabilities to instill in large language models (LLMs).
claim: 作者指出，传统范式通常需要数万到数十万示例，基于两个假设：掌握复杂认知过程需要大量监督示范，且监督微调主要导致记忆而非真正泛化 [S1.p1]。

quote: We argue this data-intensive paradigm may no longer be necessary.
claim: 作者认为这种数据密集范式可能不再必要，因为现代基础模型已在预训练中编码大量数学知识，挑战从知识获取转变为知识激发 [S1.p2]。

quote: sophisticated reasoning capabilities can emerge through minimal but precisely orchestrated demonstrations of cognitive processes.
claim: 论文提出 LIMO 假说：在预训练已全面编码领域知识的基础模型中，复杂推理可通过少量但精确编排的认知过程示范涌现，其两个前提是模型参数中潜在具备前置知识，以及推理链能将复杂问题分解为详细逻辑步骤 [S3.p1]。

quote: we first applied a baseline difficulty filter using a short-CoT mathematical model, Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct.
claim: 作者构建了一个多层筛选的数据集：先用 Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct 过滤简单题，再用 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 采样 32 次，保留仅 1–3 次成功的难题，得到 2,125 题的 LIMO-Pool [S3.SS1.SSS1.p3]。

quote: we employed three state-of-the-art reasoning models—DeepSeek R1, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, and QwQ-32B
claim: 随后用 DeepSeek R1、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 和 QwQ-32B 生成推理链，并按 elaborated reasoning、self-verification、exploratory approach、adaptive granularity 四个维度加权评分，选出最高分的 800 条构成 LIMO 数据集 [S3.SS1.SSS2.p1][S3.SS1.SSS2.p6][S3.SS1.SSS2.p7]。

quote: we implemented a rule-based scoring system that calculated weighted metrics for each dimension.
claim: 随后用 DeepSeek R1、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 和 QwQ-32B 生成推理链，并按 elaborated reasoning、self-verification、exploratory approach、adaptive granularity 四个维度加权评分，选出最高分的 800 条构成 LIMO 数据集 [S3.SS1.SSS2.p1][S3.SS1.SSS2.p6][S3.SS1.SSS2.p7]。

quote: we selected the highest-scoring solution for each problem, ranked these pairs by quality score, and extracted the top 800 to form the LIMO Dataset.
claim: 随后用 DeepSeek R1、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 和 QwQ-32B 生成推理链，并按 elaborated reasoning、self-verification、exploratory approach、adaptive granularity 四个维度加权评分，选出最高分的 800 条构成 LIMO 数据集 [S3.SS1.SSS2.p1][S3.SS1.SSS2.p6][S3.SS1.SSS2.p7]。

quote: We fine-tune Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct using supervised fine-tuning on our LIMO dataset.
claim: 训练上，作者对 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 进行全参数监督微调，使用 DeepSpeed ZeRO-3、FlashAttention-2、学习率 5.0e-6、余弦衰减、无 warmup、15 个 epoch、batch size 64 [S4.p2]。

quote: Our primary evaluation suite includes several well-established mathematical competitions and benchmarks: the American Invitational Mathematics Examination (AIME24), MATH500, and the American Mathematics Competitions (AMC23).
claim: 论文在域内基准 AIME24、MATH500、AMC23 上评估，并在三类分布外基准上测试：OlympiadBench 等数学竞赛、CHMath/Gaokao/Kaoyan/GradeSchool 等中文新构建基准、以及 Minerva 和 GPQA 等多学科基准 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: First, we include diverse mathematical competitions like OlympiadBench to test performance on different mathematical challenges.
claim: 论文在域内基准 AIME24、MATH500、AMC23 上评估，并在三类分布外基准上测试：OlympiadBench 等数学竞赛、CHMath/Gaokao/Kaoyan/GradeSchool 等中文新构建基准、以及 Minerva 和 GPQA 等多学科基准 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: We evaluate performance using the pass@1 metric in a zero-shot chain-of-thought setting across all benchmarks.
claim: 评估采用零样本思维链下的 pass@1，大基准用贪心解码单样本，小于 50 题的小基准生成 4 个样本（temperature=0.6）计算无偏 pass@1，最大输出长度 32,768 token [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: These include OpenAI-o1-preview, a large language model that has demonstrated advanced mathematical reasoning abilities across various complex tasks; QwQ-32B-Preview
claim: 对比基线包括 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，以及用 OpenThoughts-114k 和 NuminaMath-100k 微调的同骨干模型 [S6.SS1.p1][S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: These comparative datasets include OpenThoughts-114k, a synthetic reasoning dataset containing 114k examples
claim: 对比基线包括 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，以及用 OpenThoughts-114k 和 NuminaMath-100k 微调的同骨干模型 [S6.SS1.p1][S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: For AIME24, LIMO achieves 63.3% accuracy, outperforming QwQ-32B-Preview (50.0%) and OpenAI-o1-preview (44.6%) by significant margins.
claim: 在域内任务上，LIMO 在所有基准上取得最佳结果：AIME24 达 63.3%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 50.0% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 44.6%；MATH500 达 95.6%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 89.8% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 85.5%；AMC23 达 96.3%，对比 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 83.6% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: On OlympiadBench, LIMO achieves 67.6% accuracy, significantly outperforming QwQ-32B-Preview (58.5%) and the base model (45.3%).
claim: 在分布外任务上，LIMO 在 OlympiadBench 达 67.6%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 58.5% 和基座的 45.3%；CHMath 为 84.2% 对 68.5%，GradeSchool 为 76.2% 对 63.8%；GPQA 达 70.7%，接近 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 73.3% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: NuminaMath-100k shows significant degradation (32.3% vs. base model’s 49.9%) due to uncurated reasoning chains
claim: 与更大数据集相比，NuminaMath-100k 显著退化（32.3% 对基座 49.9%），OpenThoughts-114k 为 58.3%，而 LIMO 的 800 题达到 78.1% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: LIMO achieves the highest average performance of 78.1% across all benchmarks, substantially outperforming OpenAI-o1-preview, QwQ-32B-Preview, and other baselines.
claim: LIMO 在所有基准上的平均性能为 78.1%，超过 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview 等基线 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1]。

quote: L5-trained models achieve highest results on both AIME24 and MATH500, with performance decreasing consistently with each quality level.
claim: 分析还表明，推理链质量越高模型性能越好，L5 训练模型在 AIME24 和 MATH500 上最高 [S6.SS3.SSS1.p3]；

quote: modifying problem selection alone leads to 16% accuracy improvement on AIME2024, reaching 51.5%.
claim: 仅改变问题难度即可在 AIME2024 上带来 16% 提升，Advanced-500 训练的模型在 MATH500 上达 91.2% [S6.SS3.SSS2.p1]；

quote: LIMO (built on Qwen2.5) achieves 63.3% accuracy on AIME2024, a 54.1 percentage point improvement over Qwen1.5’s 9.2%.
claim: 预训练模型选择影响巨大，LIMO（Qwen2.5）在 AIME2024 上比 Qwen1.5 高 54.1 个百分点 [S6.SS3.SSS3.p2]；

quote: The difference in performance between the 32B and 72B models is marginal on MATH500 (95.6% vs. 94.8%) and slightly less pronounced on AIME24 (63.3% vs. 68.3%).
claim: 模型规模增大带来提升，但 32B 与 72B 在 MATH500 上差异很小（95.6% vs. 94.8%），AIME24 上为 63.3% vs. 68.3%，可能存在饱和点 [S6.SS3.SSS4.p1]；

quote: Fine-tuning with just 400 samples yields dramatic improvement over the base model, increasing AIME24 accuracy from 16.5 to 57.5 and MATH500 accuracy from 79.4 to 94.8.
claim: 仅 400 样本即可将 AIME24 从 16.5 提升到 57.5、MATH500 从 79.4 提升到 94.8，超过 800 样本后收益递减 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: though the lower bound for maintaining effective performance remains an open question.
claim: 作者在样本效率分析中明确指出，维持有效性能所需的最低样本量仍是一个开放问题 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: Future work could explore active learning strategies to further optimize sample efficiency.
claim: 此外，作者提出未来工作可探索主动学习策略以进一步优化样本效率 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: vision-language models currently face developmental bottlenecks, including computational complexity, limited contextual understanding, poor fine-grained visual perception, and inconsistent performance across varied sequence length.
claim: 论文指出当前视觉语言模型面临计算复杂度、上下文理解有限、细粒度视觉感知不足以及不同序列长度下性能不一致等发展瓶颈 [S1.p3]。

quote: we are committed to exploring fine-grained perception capabilities, aiming to establish a robust foundation for LVLMs and create an agentic amplifier for real-world applications.
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 旨在探索细粒度感知能力，为 LVLMs 建立坚实基础，并打造面向真实应用的智能体放大器 [S1.p1]。

quote: The overall model architecture of Qwen2.5-VL consists of three components:
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 的架构由大语言模型、视觉编码器和基于 MLP 的视觉-语言合并器三部分组成 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: we incorporate 2D-RoPE and window attention to support native input resolutions while accelerating the computation of the entire visual encoder.
claim: 视觉编码器重新设计 ViT，采用 2D-RoPE 和窗口注意力以支持原生输入分辨率并加速计算，仅四层使用全自注意力 [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.SSS1.p1]。

quote: only four layers employ full self-attention, while the remaining layers utilize windowed attention with a maximum window size of 112×112
claim: 视觉编码器重新设计 ViT，采用 2D-RoPE 和窗口注意力以支持原生输入分辨率并加速计算，仅四层使用全自注意力 [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.SSS1.p1]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL dynamically converts images of varying sizes into sequences of tokens with corresponding lengths.
claim: 模型在空间上动态将不同尺寸图像转换为相应长度的 token 序列，在时间上引入动态帧率训练和绝对时间编码，将 MRoPE 的时间 ID 与绝对时间对齐 [S2.SS1.SSS2.p2][S2.SS1.SSS2.p3][S2.SS1.SSS3.p3]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL incorporates dynamic frame rate (FPS) training and absolute time encoding.
claim: 模型在空间上动态将不同尺寸图像转换为相应长度的 token 序列，在时间上引入动态帧率训练和绝对时间编码，将 MRoPE 的时间 ID 与绝对时间对齐 [S2.SS1.SSS2.p2][S2.SS1.SSS2.p3][S2.SS1.SSS3.p3]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL introduces a key improvement: aligning the temporal component of MRoPE with absolute time.
claim: 模型在空间上动态将不同尺寸图像转换为相应长度的 token 序列，在时间上引入动态帧率训练和绝对时间编码，将 MRoPE 的时间 ID 与绝对时间对齐 [S2.SS1.SSS2.p2][S2.SS1.SSS2.p3][S2.SS1.SSS3.p3]。

quote: comparing it with state-of-the-art models such as Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620, GPT-4o-0513, InternVL2.5, and different sizes of Qwen2-VL.
claim: 实验将 Qwen2.5-VL 与 Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620、GPT-4o-0513、InternVL2.5 以及不同规模的 Qwen2-VL 等模型进行比较 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: we conducted extensive experiments across a diverse range of datasets.
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个基准 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS3.p1][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: We evaluated our models across a diverse range of OCR, chart, and document understanding benchmarks.
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个基准 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS3.p1][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: We evaluated Qwen2.5-VL’s grounding capabilities on the referring expression comprehension benchmarks, object detection in the wild, self-curated point grounding benchmark, and CountBench.
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个基准 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS3.p1][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: We assessed our models across a diverse range of video understanding and grounding tasks
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个基准 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS3.p1][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: We assess the agent capabilities of Qwen2.5-VL through various aspects.
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个基准 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS3.p1][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: we capped the maximum number of frames analyzed per video at 768, with the total number of video tokens not exceeding 24,576.
claim: 视频评估中每个视频最多分析 768 帧，视频 token 总数不超过 24,576 [S3.SS3.SSS4.p2]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves a score of 70.2 on MMMU.
claim: 在 MMMU 上 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 取得 70.2 分，MMMU-Pro 得 51.1 分，超过此前开源最优模型并与 GPT-4o 相当 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: On MathVista, it achieves a score of 74.8, outperforming the previous open-source state-of-the-art score of 72.3.
claim: 在 MathVista 上取得 74.8 分，超过此前开源最优的 72.3 分 [S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: largely exceeding best model Gemini 1.5-Pro by 9.6% and 20.6% for English and Chinese track respectively.
claim: 在 OCRBench_v2 上，Qwen2.5-VL 在英文和中文赛道分别超过最佳模型 Gemini 1.5-Pro 9.6% 和 20.6% [S3.SS3.SSS2.p4]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves an impressive mIoU score of 50.9, thereby surpassing the performance of GPT-4o.
claim: 在视频定位的 Charades-STA 上，Qwen2.5-VL-72B 取得 50.9 的 mIoU，超过 GPT-4o [S3.SS3.SSS4.p2]。

quote: setting a new standard on ScreenSpot Pro with 43.6% accuracy - far surpassing both Aguvis-72B (23.6%) and its foundation Qwen2-VL-72B (1.6%).
claim: 在 ScreenSpot Pro 上取得 43.6% 准确率，远超 Aguvis-72B 的 23.6% 和 Qwen2-VL-72B 的 1.6% [S3.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: Intermediate reasoning steps may fail to adequately integrate visual information, either by ignoring relevant visual cues or misinterpreting them.
claim: 作者指出，在将思维链推理应用于视觉语言模型时，中间推理步骤可能无法充分整合视觉信息，要么忽略相关视觉线索，要么误解它们；尽管开发了基于规则和模型驱动的过滤策略来验证中间推理步骤，实现最优的模态对齐仍是一个持续存在的挑战，需要进一步改进 [S2.SS3.SSS3.p4]。
